aircraft: Gavilan-XP (the X-wing with a hawk's feet)
note: kinematics and hand estimates; NOT a contact simulation

events.event: trigger on the perch: motors start
lift-off and tip-over: the sprint begins
peak speed 48 m/s: the flare begins, nose up, belly first
the legs swing out of the belly (0.27 s), the toes spread to 168 mm
legs out and still, the camera on the bandit
the trigger: the toes are let go 28 ms before the contact
contact at 1.5 m/s: the toes shut round the bandit's body
the bind: the two move together at 0.8 m/s, the legs took 20 N
steadied in a hang, the bandit held under the belly
set down after a descent from 30 m at 2 m/s

feet.source: hand estimate: nothing chosen or tested
